run_zerodepth_demo: run the demo script to predict depth from RGB images using the ZeroDepth model on a Stretch robot
run_depth_prediction: run the ZeroDepth model to predict depth from a single RGB image captured by the robot head camera
run_depth_comparison: run the demo to compare predicted depth against actual depth sensor readings side by side
run_point_cloud_visualization: run the demo to visualize original and predicted depth as 3D point clouds using show_point_cloud
run_intrinsics_extraction: run the demo to extract camera intrinsics from the Stretch robot head and use them for depth prediction
